name: OpenCart
description: OpenCart is a free, open-source PHP-based ecommerce platform for building and managing online stores, with no monthly platform fees.
best_for: Small businesses, developers, and agencies who want a free, self-hosted, highly extensible storefront without recurring platform fees.

tiers.name: Core (self-hosted, open source)
tiers.notes: Free download and free updates with zero license fees; the full source is on GitHub. Hosting is provided and paid for separately by the store owner.

cons: The official marketplace enforces a minimum extension price of $29.99 — nearly all functional add-ons such as payment gateways, SEO tools, and shipping modules carry real costs on top of the free platform.

OpenCart's own hosted OpenCart Cloud product does not publish clear pricing anywhere on its official pages, and third-party trackers report inconsistent figures for it, making cloud hosting costs unverifiable from opencart.com itself.

Support is not included with the free platform — Dedicated Support is a separate paid service with no public price listed anywhere on opencart.com, so total cost of ownership beyond the free core software is opaque.
features: Fully mobile-friendly admin area with product, order, and customer management
36 payment methods built in, with hundreds more available via the marketplace
Module-based system for extending functionality with themes and plugins
OpenCart marketplace offering 13,000+ modules and themes
Support for 40+ languages, including right-to-left languages like Arabic and Hebrew
Built-in sales reporting and marketing tools
No monthly licensing fees since the core platform is free and open source
